components.name: Small toucan
components.function: New distinct tropical forms. Bird twowings/twolegs and coherent bigbeak, gecko fourlegs/fivetoes/onetail, frog fourlegs, beetle sixlegs/twoantennae. No jewelry or fused branch/pedestal.
components.construction: One isolated small toucan. New distinct tropical forms. Bird twowings/twolegs and coherent bigbeak, gecko fourlegs/fivetoes/onetail, frog fourlegs, beetle sixlegs/twoantennae. No jewelry or fused branch/pedestal. Dimensions are proposals to refine by subject.
